prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished illustrated background for a colorful cartoon water-gun arena game's start screen and local custom room lobby.
Primary request: a joyful sunlit seaside water-play arena plaza, a curved turquoise shallow pool in the foreground, coral red and cobalt blue inflatable cover and chunky water-gun practice props along the sides, a small seaside clubhouse with red and blue awnings, pastel sand-colored paths, palm trees, warm summer sky with fluffy clouds and a few glossy bubbles. Original stylized 3D cartoon game key art, sculptural simple shapes, toy-like polished materials, bright cyan ocean, coral and sunny yellow accents. Strong professional game splash-screen composition, scenic depth, wide panoramic landscape 16:9.
Composition: frame scenic details and colorful props around the outer left and right sides, keep the central 45 percent spacious with a soft sky / distant water backdrop for a live game title and central start button. No people or characters. No lettering, numbers, signs, logos or watermark. Not an interface mockup, no buttons or UI baked into the artwork.
Lighting: fresh clear daylight, soft ambient shadows, polished inviting playful mood.
